channel.title: New York Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: British ‘Lip King’ Jordan James Parke dead at 34, two people arrested
item.description: Parke's death may have followed a recent cosmetic procedure, police said.

item.title: Lisa Rinna believes she was drugged at ‘Traitors’ premiere party
item.description: Lisa Rinna may have been drugged at the premiere party for her hit show "Traitors." Her co-star Colton Underwood reportedly expressed concern.

item.title: Family no longer financially supporting Nick Reiner in murder defense: report
item.description: Nick Reiner is not receiving financial support from family for his defense in the killings of his parents, Rob and Michele Singer Reiner, according to a report.

item.title: U.S. women’s hockey team declines Trump’s SoTU invitation
item.description: The U.S. women's hockey team will not attend President Trump's State of the Union speech. The men's squad is expected to be there Tuesday night.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie kidnapping suspect appeared to have made a previous visit
item.description: Evidence suggests the man suspected of kidnapping Nancy Guthrie may have paid an earlier visit to the 84-year-old missing woman's Arizona home.

item.title: Advocates demand arrests after NYPD officers pelted with snowballs at West Village park
item.description: Video uploaded to social media at 5:48 p.m. shows the officers being battered by snowballs outside the Washington Square Park Office and restrooms as dozens of parkgoers crowd around filming and jeering at the cops.

item.title: Slew of subway vandalism ahead of snow day
item.description: Suspected vandals broke into a parked B train Sunday night, one of several subway vandalism incidents reported on the eve of Monday's blizzard.

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein accusers to attend Trump’s State of the Union address
item.description: Democratic lawmaker plan to bring roughly 12 Jeffrey Epstein accusers to President Trump's State of the Union address.

item.title: Off-duty NYPD cop pepper-sprayed in Brooklyn during argument over shoveling snow
item.description: An off-duty NYPD police officer was shoved and pepper-sprayed following an argument over shoveling snow in Brooklyn Monday, a law enforcement source told the Daily News.
